nodes.label: No Booking Engine Rule
nodes.rationale: Online reservation system is explicitly prohibited; WhatsApp CTA is the sole conversion path.

nodes.label: Once-Per-Visitor Door Animation Rule
nodes.rationale: Door intro animation plays once per visitor stored in localStorage/cookie so return visitors are not slowed down.

nodes.label: Central WhatsApp Config Rule
nodes.rationale: WhatsApp phone number must reside in Supabase and be admin-editable so changes propagate everywhere at once without code deploy.

nodes.label: Visual Inspiration vs Scope Guardrail
nodes.rationale: Do not copy multi-property features, loyalty tiers, or restaurant chains.

nodes.label: Unfinalized Content Placeholders
nodes.rationale: Exact room prices, exact hotel address/coords, facilities list, rules, offers, and real photos are pending owner confirmation.

nodes.label: Owner Content Management Admin Panel
nodes.rationale: Owner-only access to update rooms, images, pricing, text, rules, offers, and WhatsApp number without code changes.

nodes.label: Cinematic First-Visit Entrance
nodes.rationale: Double door opening sequence revealing hotel branding and hero view on first visit.

nodes.label: Target WhatsApp Customer Journey
nodes.rationale: Website -> View Room -> Ask on WhatsApp -> Owner handles availability, negotiation and booking offline.

nodes.label: WhatsApp CTA with Contextual Pre-fill
nodes.rationale: Contextual pre-filled message specifying Standard or Premium room inquiries.

nodes.label: Supabase Auth & Owner RLS
nodes.rationale: Row-level security ensures only the owner's authenticated session can write or mutate content.

nodes.label: Supabase Postgres & Storage Backend
nodes.rationale: Stores rooms, display prices, media, festival offers, policies, and global WhatsApp number. Public site reads only.

nodes.label: Agent Working Rules & Boundaries
nodes.rationale: Enforce hard scope boundaries: Dollar Hotel only, no booking engine, no fabricated facts, once-per-visitor door intro, and Supabase WhatsApp number propagation.

nodes.label: Visual Direction & Luxury Aesthetic
nodes.rationale: Borrow luxury hotel group aesthetic (cinematic feel, clean typography, whitespace) without copying group features.
